utilitySource:
#!/bin/sh
# Take a screenshot of the current screen and save it as a .png,
# using the xofm/modules/usersignaltrigger

pid=$(pgrep xochitl)
if [ -z "$pid" ]; then
    echo "Error: xochitl process not running"
    exit 1
fi

if kill -USR2 "$pid"; then
    echo "Screenshot taken, stored as a .png at /home/root"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to send signal to xochitl"
    exit 1
fi
invocation: screenshot --help (stock script ignores arguments, invokes native SIGUSR2 once)
displayDeviceMetadata:
UTILITY screenshot /usr/bin/screenshot
UTILITY dbus-send /usr/bin/dbus-send
UTILITY fbset /usr/sbin/fbset
UTILITY busybox /usr/bin/busybox
CAPABILITY_NODE /dev/dri/card0 character special file 660 0 44
note: No screenshot claimed. Target only recent top-level PNG metadata and installed-capability/service metadata; no old image content read or returned.
